verdict.rationale: HeyGen's documentation says it can translate any video into 70+ languages with AI dubbing and lip sync, and translation scripts can be edited and proofread. Independent community viewers corroborate a real translated, dubbed and lip-synced speech as convincing. The concern about verifying translation fidelity is skepticism, not a failure of the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs stating explicitly that the original speaker's own voice is cloned and carried into the target language; detailed workflow or limit documentation beyond one-line claims.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can translate a finished video into other languages with the voice and lip sync carried over

citations.quote: Translate any video into 70+ languages with AI dubbing and lip sync.
